items.title: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
items.summary: Each day brings news of another AI-powered attack, or a newly discovered vulnerability. Here’s what’s happening and how ordinary people can protect themselves online.

items.title: The chart bitcoin traders should be paying attention to
items.summary: A market at an inflection point could shape inflation trends and the prices of risk assets, from bitcoin to tech stocks.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly dips below $80,000 as tech jitters and hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Alphabet and Samsung-drove tech weakness and a hawkish Fed hold triggered a broad risk-off move. Crypto futures saw $356 million in liquidations.

items.title: Mystery Wall Street Journal ad sparks new fight over tokenized stocks
items.summary: A full-page warning urging CEOs to opt out of tokenized stock trading drew a response from Securitize and questions over who paid for it.

items.title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
items.summary: BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.

items.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
items.summary: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

items.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
items.summary: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.

items.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
items.summary: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

items.title: Walmart, Eli Lilly join growing pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
items.summary: Five more companies have objected, bringing the total to 38 as a rival Canton venue prepares to launch with an issuer-sponsored stock under the SEC's innovation exemption.

items.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
items.summary: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

items.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
items.summary: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

items.title: U.S. sanctions Russian nationals for laundering millions in crypto for North Korean IT workers
items.summary: Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas allegedly converted about $3.5 million and nearly $2 million in crypto, respectively, for North Korea.

items.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

items.title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
items.summary: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

items.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
items.summary: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.

items.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
items.summary: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin clings to $80,000 as Samsung and Google tumble after earnings
items.summary: Coming shortly is a key government inflation report; coming after the close on Thursday are quarterly earnings from the leading corporate bitcoin holder, Strategy.

items.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
items.summary: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.
